Messages.Author: Rafid Armani
Messages.Body:
1- If Vampire A attempts to rescue himself from torpor, Vampire B
blocks and Vampire A play a Kiss of Ra in major. Can Vampire B
diablerize Vampire A ?

2- Can a torporized vampire can do a Wake or a Forced Awakening ?

3- Can a tapped vampire in torpor can do a Reform Body ?

4- Some players here think that Ranjan Rishi is an old woman... what
do you think ?

Thanks

Rafid

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Rafid Armani wrote:
>
> 1- If Vampire A attempts to rescue himself from torpor, Vampire B
> blocks and Vampire A play a Kiss of Ra in major. Can Vampire B
> diablerize Vampire A ?

* Only ready vampires can commit diablerie. Vampires in Torpor cannot. [RTR 23-JUN-1998]

Also, the vampire (B) has to successfully block in the first place, something
that he never does - the block attempt if thwarted by Kiss of Ra (card text).

> 2- Can a torporized vampire can do a Wake or a Forced Awakening ?

No. [1.6.3.5] [6.5.1]

> 3- Can a tapped vampire in torpor can do a Reform Body ?

Also [1.6.3.5] [6.5.1]

Another quick question :

If I use Flesh of Marble in minor, the opposing minion hits me for 2
normal + 2 agg, I guess I take 1 damage + 2 agg ?

Can I then use Fortitude cards to prevent the damage after the damage

If not, before ?

So, if I use FoM in sup and opposing minion hits me for 4 normal
damage, can I let the FoM reduces it to 1 and play a Resilience in
minor ?

Thanks for your time,

Rafid

Messages.Author: Gomi no Sensei
Messages.Body:
In article <3aa61c23....@news.videotron.ca>,
Rafid Armani <ra...@videotron.ca> wrote:

>If I use Flesh of Marble in minor, the opposing minion hits me for 2
>normal + 2 agg, I guess I take 1 damage + 2 agg ?

Yup. See current cardtext for Flesh of Marble, available at

http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/Cardlist_F.html#Flesh_of_Marble

Flesh of Marble [Jyhad, V:TES]
Cardtype: Combat
Discipline: Protean
Only usable before range is chosen. If the vampire takes [(and does not
prevent)] more than 1 damage in a round, excess damage is prevented,
although aggravated damage cannot be prevented. This lasts for the
duration of the combat. (S) As above, but aggravated damage can be prevented.

>Can I then use Fortitude cards to prevent the damage after the damage
>reduction by FoM ?

Nope. See cardtext. You have to be done with all your other damage prevention
effects before FoM kicks in.

>If not, before ?

Sure, why not?

>So, if I use FoM in sup and opposing minion hits me for 4 normal
>damage, can I let the FoM reduces it to 1 and play a Resilience in
>minor ?

Nope. FoM reduces all unprevented damage to 1, at which time it's no longer
preventable (since you've passed on your chances to play Resilience et alias
before FoM takes effect).

gomi
